about_the_game:
Multiplayer Mayhem: 100 Players, 50 Duels

  • The Platform redefines multiplayer gaming. A lobby of 100 players awaits your entry, each destined to battle it out in pairs—two contenders per floor. This setup guarantees relentless, head-to-head encounters where strategy, trust, and quick thinking determine who survives the chaos. Form alliances, deceive rivals, and brace yourself for a descent where every floor tells its own story of survival.



    Are You Ready to Survive?

  • Prepare for a descent into a world where every level holds a new trial, every encounter sparks tension, and alliances can shatter in an instant. The Platform invites you to redefine what it means to survive in a society on the brink of collapse. Embrace the chaos, master your fate, and show that even in the darkest depths, the human spirit can prevail.

Enter The Platform—and let the battle for survival begin.

short_description: Step into a towering vertical maze where every floor is a battleground for survival. In The Platform, scarce resources trickle down from an elusive upper level, igniting a brutal struggle among those desperate enough to claim them.
